evaluation_metrics.retrieval_accuracy: Percentage of relevant products found that match LLM-generated descriptions
evaluation_metrics.requirement_extraction: Accuracy of extracted technical and business requirements
evaluation_metrics.semantic_relevance: Semantic similarity between LLM descriptions and retrieved products
evaluation_metrics.category_matching: Accuracy of product category identification and retrieval
evaluation_metrics.specification_alignment: How well retrieved products match expected specifications
evaluation_metrics.hybrid_performance: Performance comparison between keyword and semantic search
evaluation_metrics.response_time: Time taken for hybrid search completion

expected_behaviors.llm_description_generation: Should generate realistic product descriptions based on requirements
expected_behaviors.vector_search_matching: Should find products that semantically match LLM descriptions
expected_behaviors.category_awareness: Should correctly identify and search within relevant product categories
expected_behaviors.specification_matching: Should retrieve products that meet specified technical requirements
expected_behaviors.hybrid_merging: Should combine and rank results from both search methods effectively
expected_behaviors.requirement_analysis: Should extract both explicit and implicit requirements accurately
expected_behaviors.context_awareness: Should consider industry and use case context in recommendations

evaluation_approach.realistic_scoring: Score based on semantic similarity and specification matching, not exact name matching
evaluation_approach.category_accuracy: Evaluate if retrieved products belong to the expected categories
evaluation_approach.specification_coverage: Check if retrieved products meet the technical specifications mentioned
evaluation_approach.business_relevance: Assess if recommendations align with business requirements and budget
evaluation_approach.semantic_quality: Measure how well the LLM descriptions match the actual retrieved products
